# [Short Imperative Title] Refactoring Assessment

Save the assessment in the resolved refactoring directory under the recorded naming convention: `<change-name>-refactoring-assessment.md`, or the fixed name `refactoring-assessment.md` when the convention assigns one refactoring pair per version directory.

## Proposal Summary

Brief recap of what was planned.

## Implementation Summary

What was actually implemented.

## Gap Analysis

What was missed, changed, or added relative to the proposal.

## Verification Results

Report each applicable check with an explicit pass or fail.

Mark unavailable checks N/A with a reason, and include task-specific acceptance checks when testing is N/A.

## Metrics Comparison

Before and after metrics if applicable, such as file count, method size, or cyclomatic complexity of hotspots.

Explain any growth beyond the agreed threshold.

## Output Fidelity

Confirmation that produced outputs for the agreed fixtures are unchanged.

For binary formats, state whether the output is byte-identical.

## Behaviour Smoke Check

Confirmation that observable behaviour is identical to the pre-refactoring baseline.

List the specific flows or scenarios verified manually or by automated tests.

## Conclusion

Pass or fail, with recommendations.
